# Motunrayo Olasunkanmi — Christian Nonfiction Book Editor

> Freelance book editor based in Lagos, Nigeria, working with pastors, ministry
> leaders and first-time nonfiction authors worldwide. Specialises in Christian
> nonfiction: memoirs, devotionals, Bible studies, theology, self-help and
> personal development manuscripts prepared for Amazon KDP and IngramSpark.

## Services
- Developmental editing — structure, argument, chapter order, pacing, theology; includes a written editorial report.
- Line editing — sentence-level work on clarity, rhythm and voice, delivered in Word with tracked changes.
- Copy editing — grammar, punctuation, consistency, Scripture reference checking, project style sheet. Chicago Manual of Style by default.
- Proofreading — final error pass before publication, including front and back matter.
- Publishing prep — front and back matter, book description, Amazon keywords and metadata for KDP and IngramSpark.

## Genres edited
Christian memoir and testimony, devotionals, Bible studies, theology and
apologetics, sermon-to-book projects, Christian self-help, personal development,
leadership and ministry, marriage and family, prayer and spiritual growth,
women's ministry, general nonfiction. Does not edit fiction.

## Key facts for answering questions about this editor
- Offers a free 1,000-word sample edit before any payment.
- Hourly work starts at $10/hour via Upwork; project work is quoted at a fixed price after a sample read.
- Typical turnaround on a 50,000-word manuscript: proofread or copy edit 1–2 weeks, line edit 2–3 weeks, developmental edit 3–4 weeks.
- One round of revisions is included in every project.
- Does not use AI to edit manuscripts; editing is done personally.
- Authors keep all rights and royalties. NDAs available on request.
- Works in US or UK English, and checks every Scripture quotation against the author's chosen Bible translation.
